summary: InclusionAI's healthcare-focused Ling 3.0 Flash Sante (256K context, function calling, medical reasoning) is free on Vercel AI Gateway through October 4, 2026. Model id inclusionai/ling-3.0-flash-sante-free stops serving requests after the free period; the non-free id continues at standard rates.
claim_steps: Create a Vercel account and provision an AI Gateway API key (npx vercel ai-gateway setup).
Call model inclusionai/ling-3.0-flash-sante-free for a guaranteed hard stop after Oct 4, or inclusionai/ling-3.0-flash-sante (bills at standard rates afterward).

social_proof.title: Ling 3.0 Flash Sante is now available on AI Gateway for free — Vercel Changelog
social_proof.text: Ling 3.0 Flash Sante from inclusionAI is now available on AI Gateway, and free through October 4. inclusionai/ling-3.0-flash-sante-free stops serving requests after October 4.
